name: Alameda County Behavioral Health Provider Directory
description: Alameda County Behavioral Health's ACCESS line and online provider directory help Medi-Cal members and uninsured residents find mental health clinics, substance use treatment, and community resources throughout the county.
fullDescription: Alameda County Behavioral Health's ACCESS line and online provider directory help Medi-Cal members and uninsured residents find mental health clinics, substance use treatment, and community resources throughout the county.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 ACCESS line for mental health screening and referrals
- Substance Use Access & Referral Helpline (screening, assessment, referral, care coordination)
- Online provider directory (acbh.my.site.com/ProviderDirectory)
- Crisis services information
- For Medi-Cal members and uninsured Alameda County residents
howToGetIt: Call the 24/7 Mental Health ACCESS line at 1-800-491-9099. For substance use services, call the Substance Use Access & Referral Helpline at 1-844-682-7215. For crisis services, call 510-891-5600.
keywords: Alameda, Oakland, East Bay, mental health, substance use, provider directory, therapist, counselor, drug treatment, psychiatrist, clinic
